firm_data.firm_description: The Merani Kamara Law Group, part of the Law Offices of Peter C. Merani, P.C., focuses on insurance law and litigation and features experienced trial litigation attorneys with proven track records. The firm has been providing high-quality legal representation and advice to its clients for over three decades.
notable_facts: The firm has handled thousands of litigation matters on behalf of their clients and over 75,000 litigation matters for insurers alone.
The firm has offices in Long Island and Manhattan, New York, and meeting offices in Washington, D.C., and Irving, Texas.
The firm was founded in 1993 by Peter C. Merani as The Law Offices of Peter C. Merani, P.C.
technology_signals: Custom IT system with case management and document management programs

email.subject: AI for The Merani Kamara Law Group, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Peter,

Your firm has handled over 75,000 litigation matters for insurers alone, and you're doing it with a custom case management system that gives you a real edge. That kind of volume demands precision at scale, especially across insurance law and appeals work.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms in New York. I'd be happy to stop by your Manhattan office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like yours compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
